You are helping the user solve a math problem. If you propose a numerical solution, you should provide it at the end of your response in the following format:
```answer
<numerical_answer>
```
Where <numerical_answer> is the numerical answer to the problem.

How many pets does Larry have? Larry has 3 cats. Larry has 3 times as many dogs as cats. Larry has 2 fewer rabbits than dogs. Larry has three times as many fish as rabbits. Larry has a collection of gerbils that is one-third the number of fish he has.
